# Cockpit 1.2.0

> The 11 Cockpit mods for Claude Code: guards that catch an agent's mistakes, and instruments that show where every session stands.

Each page below is a Markdown file. To install: `claude plugin marketplace add joaosavi/cockpit` and `claude plugin install cockpit@cockpit`, then restart Claude Code and run `/cockpit:setup`.

## Get started

- [Quickstart](https://joaosavi.github.io/cockpit/md/start.md)
- [Install and set up](https://joaosavi.github.io/cockpit/md/install.md)
- [Your first session](https://joaosavi.github.io/cockpit/md/first-session.md)
